hook: A robot arm ran chemistry kit experiments from a photo of the printed sheet, completing 9 of 10 runs.
summary: Curie's Jarvis lets a Franka Panda arm work on an ordinary bench: it reads steps from a photo, finds containers without markers, and reads their labels. It finished 5 of 5 runs of one children's kit protocol and 4 of 5 of another with no human help. In 160 label locates, it identified every container. Only two simple protocols were tested, so harder chemistry is unproven.
title: Curie's Jarvis: Autonomous Robotic Chemistry Experiments from Printed Protocols
